GitHub Issue:
Post Date: 2016-10-13T22:11:05Z
Current Date: April 4 2025
Title: Subject should throw exception when calling onNext after onComplete
Description: ```
PublishSubject publishSubject = PublishSubject.create();
publishSubject.onCompleted();
publishSubject.onNext(new Object());
```

In 1.x you can call onNext after onCompleted and no exception will be thrown. 
I think it should throw an exception, but maybe it isn't possible to reliably assert that the observable hasn't completed before calling onNext when dealing with different threads.
